claim_title: Yoga Nidra or Non-Sleep Deep Rest (NSDR) improves sleep quality
caption: **NSDR and sleep quality.** Only one study was reviewed, and sleep was just a secondary outcome — its main focus was stress, mood and cortisol. When NSDR was fairly tested against music listening, there was **no difference in sleep**, and the study tracked 14+ outcomes without adjusting for chance findings. With high dropout and a narrow, self-selected sample, the evidence can't confirm the claim.
subtitle: One study where sleep was a secondary outcome showed no reliable improvement.
